newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Slavneft 9-mth pre-tax falls to 684 bln rls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Slavneft 9-mth pre-tax falls to 684 bln rls.

text.p: AO NGK Slavneft's nine-month pre-tax profit fell to 683.9 billion roubles from 1.03 trillion roubles in the same period of 1997, the company said in a statement.
Pre-tax profit 683.9 bln rbls 1.03 trln rbls
Produced oil 12.85 million tonnes 13.23 million tonnes
Oil exports 6.22 million tonnes 6.68 million tonnes
NOTE - Slavneft, a Russian-Belarussian joint venture, is one of Russia's dozen vertically integrated oil groups. Its main operating unit is AO Megionneftegaz MFGS.RTS 0#MFGS.RUO.
Slavneft said in a statement that Megionneftegaz's pre-tax profit was 382 billion roubles and net profit was 336.1 billion. A spokesman could give no comparative data.
A cash auction for 2.14 percent of Slavneft is due to end on December 27.
